cells.why: f2-m06 says round-to-nearest realizes an entry only if 0.125 x its RL change exceeds half a bf16 ulp. 54 % of RL's changes are at most 1 ulp, so nearly all are dropped, and the edit acts like an effective a of about 0.03-0.05. On the steep plain-prompt curve (224/405/443 of 500 at a = 0/0.25/0.5) that gives about 280/500, or 168/300. run-04/f2-m03 makes the effect grow with the nominal dose, so a = 0.125 gives about 60 % of a = 0.25's plain gain: about 333/500, or 200/300.
